text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is the best I've got right 
now... It actually feels kinda nice..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good work. You beat me, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You really are amazing, huh... It's 
frustrating, but somehow I'm also really 
happy. Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... saying you're happy after losing 
is simply absurd. And with such a carefree 
look on your face, no less...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural that I defeat you at 
this distance. After all, it is my life's 
greatest ambition.

"Mejiro McQueen naturally held the upper 
hand with her experience. Even so, this 
placing was a tremendous effort."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall face you at medium 
distance, your specialty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, what race is my best-suited medium 
distance? Trainer, do you know?”

When it comes to deciding the king of 
spring medium-distance, it's the 
Takarazuka Kinen. In accordance with 
Mejiro McQueen's resolve, we set our 
sights on it.

Still, there's no telling how high up we 
can place in the fan voting.
